queries.--scripts:
preuninstall scriptlet (using /bin/sh):
if [ "$1" -eq 0 ]; then
    /usr/libexec/lyra-release-identity --restore || :
fi
posttrans scriptlet (using /bin/sh):
/usr/libexec/lyra-release-identity

# Reapply after release-file transactions, using RPM default trigger priority.
queries.--filetriggers:
transfiletriggerin scriptlet (using /bin/sh) -- /etc, /usr/lib
while IFS= read -r changed_path; do
    case "$changed_path" in
        /usr/lib/os-release|/etc/os-release)
            /usr/libexec/lyra-release-identity
            exit $?
            ;;
    esac
done
